title: MEV Tax Hook — The Codebase Explained
author: UHI10 build notes
description: The deep-dive into the second UHI10 build: the LP-first MEV tax on Unichain. Why an arbitrageur's priority fee is a truthful confession of its profit, how beforeSwapReturnDelta charges the swapper and donate pays in-range LPs with the two cancelling inside the flash-accounting lock (the hook never touches a token), the whole contract line by line, the tests that simulate a gas-market arms race, and the priority-fee-slider demo. Plus: a full competitive-landscape study against 126 prior MEV/LVR hooks and the live UHI9/UHI10 field, a plain-language walkthrough of that research, six concrete upgrade paths explained in depth, and every hard skeptical question (bots, sandwich attacks, PFDA, Guard Hook, backrunning) answered directly.
